_app_baselines_comment: THE APP-WIDE BASELINE THEMES — one per app. Not to be confused with the
presets below, which are a different system: a baseline is what an app
looks like everywhere, and a preset is what one merchant picks for their
own venue's pages. The collision is real and deliberate to guard against:
'Bissap Bloom' here is the customer app's whole look, while 'bissap' in
presets is one hibiscus accent a merchant may choose. In Dart they are
EstablishmentThemePreset respectively, and nothing is named plain
